<!--
  THIS DESCRIPTION BECOMES THE CHANGELOG ENTRY AND THE RELEASE NOTES.

  Merging a PR from `development` into `main` cuts a release: the version is bumped, this text is
  written into CHANGELOG.md under the new version heading, a tag is pushed and a GitHub Release is
  created with the same text as its body. Write it for someone reading it in six months, not for the
  reviewer reading it today -- the entries already in CHANGELOG.md are the house style.

  These comments are stripped before any of that, so leave them in.

  HOW FAR THE VERSION MOVES (1.<breaking>.<feature>.<fix>):
    - a `release:breaking`, `release:feature` or `release:fix` label on this PR decides;
    - failing that, an uncommented `Release: <level>` line anywhere below;
    - failing that, `fix`.
  Add the `no-release` label to merge without cutting a release at all.

  `#` and `##` headings are demoted to `###` so they nest under the version heading. Headings deeper
  than that, lists, code fences and links all pass through untouched.
-->
